units.source_text: “千重子小姐，你可以给你家的掌柜……哦，现在是公司的什么专务、常务来点厉害的脸色瞧瞧吗？

en.t: Miss Chieko, could you show your family's head clerk... oh, now he is some company executive director or managing director, a really stern look?
You can manage that sort of thing, can't you, Miss Chieko?

units.source_text: 需要的话，我也可以给你助助威……”

en.t: If you need me to, I can also give you a little encouragement..."
